source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.8.2, printed page 176.

items: Jab balanced equation mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon to units cancel ho jati hain aur equilibrium constant ki koi unit nahi hoti.

blocks.text: Ester banne ki reaction solution mein hoti hai aur is mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar hain, is liye Kc ki koi unit nahi.

blocks.latex: K_c = \frac{[\ce{CH3COOC2H5}]\,[\ce{H2O}]}{[\ce{CH3COOH_{(aq)}}]\,[\ce{C2H5OH_{(aq)}}]} = \frac{\text{mol dm}^{-3} \times \text{mol dm}^{-3}}{\text{mol dm}^{-3} \times \text{mol dm}^{-3}} = \text{no units}
blocks.text_alt: Kc = [CH₃COOC₂H₅][H₂O] / [CH₃COOH(aq)][C₂H₅OH(aq)] = (mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³) / (mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³) = no units

items: Jab moles barabar na hon to equilibrium constant ki value istemal ki gayi units par depend karti hai. Haber process se NH₃ banane mein reactants aur products ki units cancel nahi hotin.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Units nikalne ka tareeqa: har concentration ki jagah mol dm⁻³ likhein aur cancel karein. Oopar 2 aur neeche 4 concentrations hon to 2 bachti hain neeche: 1 / (mol dm⁻³)² = mol⁻² dm⁶. (Kitab ne numerator mein 'mols' likha hai; yeh sirf 'mol' hai.)

blocks.prompt: In mein se kis ke Kc ki unit (concentration)⁻¹ hai: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃; H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI; 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄; 2HF ⇌ H₂ + F₂?
blocks.explanation: 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄: Kc = [N₂O₄] / [NO₂]², units mol dm⁻³ / (mol dm⁻³)² = (mol dm⁻³)⁻¹. Ammonia wali reaction (concentration)⁻² deti hai, aur baqi do mein dono taraf moles barabar hain, is liye koi unit nahi.

items: Dono taraf moles barabar: Kc ki koi unit nahi (ester banna).
Moles barabar nahi: unit rehti hai (ammonia: mol⁻² dm⁶), aur value chuni hui units par depend karti hai.
